resources.string: This build does not monitor Android battery, temperature or network status. Actual energy use and savings have not been measured.
Android battery, battery saver, thermal status and the default network are observed only while Discover is visible in the foreground. Actual energy use and savings have not been measured.
System observation has stopped. Replenishment is paused until valid signals are obtained again.
System observation or expiry checks are unavailable, so replenishment is paused. Leave Discover and return; restart the app if it remains unavailable.
Recent system observations are available. Each observation expires after five minutes without an update. Refresh updates signals only; it does not automatically replenish results.
Some system observations are unknown or expired. This does not mean zero battery or device failure. Refresh system signals, then explicitly discover or change pages once they are valid.
The policy update is incomplete. Discovery requests are paused conservatively.
System signals are not connected. Replenishment is limited by the selected static mode, foreground and page visibility, and actual saving or recording activity.
%1$s allow the existing budget without raising the static mode or other limits.
%1$s reduce the replenishment budget. This is not a measurement of energy saved.
%1$s are unknown or require a pause. Source requests are stopped; existing local results remain available.
Effective budget: concurrent request limit: %1$d; attempts per round: %2$d; low/high watermarks: %3$d/%4$d.
Signal changes only reduce or stop current demand. Recovery does not automatically start another round. Actual saving or recording always takes priority.
